newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: RESEARCH ALERT-Hanwha Chem cut to "sell".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Hanwha Chem cut to "sell".

text.p: ING-Baring Securities Ltd said on Monday it was downgrading its recommendation on Hanwha Chemical Corp to a "sell" from a "hold" due to Hanwha's inability to deal with continued high raw material costs.
Continued losses in Hanwha's processed goods division contributed to the downgrade, the brokerage house said.

Furthermore, the company's heavy capital expansion burden would provide little relief to its heavy debt load during the onset of a potentially long-term weakness in the petrochemical cycle, the brokerage house said in a report.
"Its high gearing to petrochemicals and financially stressed non-petrochemical divisions make the counter unattractive despite its stable cash flow," it said.
The brokerage said it was lowering its forecast for Hanwha's net profit for this year to seven billion won from its earlier forecast of 13 billion.
The forecast for next year's net profit was also revised to six billion won from the former 14 billion, it said.
